Shabd, saral bhasha mein

Kitaab mein sikhaaye gaye har shabd ka matlab, alphabet ke kram mein, us chapter ke saath jahan woh pehli baar samjhaya gaya. Kul 236 shabd.

ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW

A

A/B test
ek badlaav ko users ke ek yaadrichhik aadhe ko dikhana aur doosre aadhe se tulna karna; yaadrichhikta hi aapko kehne deti hai ki badlaav ne farak paida kiya Chapter 44
AARRR
growth ke paanch charan, har ek ko ek ginti yogya event diya gaya: acquisition, activation, retention, referral aur revenue Chapter 43
abstention
ek system ka jawaab na dene ka faisla karna, aur yeh kehna, jab uske paas saboot nahi hai; yeh ek product vyavahaar hai jise design kiya jaana hai, nirdesh mein ek vaakya nahi Chapter 35
acceptance criteria
woh shartein jo kaam ke ek tukde ko "ho gaya" maane jaane ke liye poori karni hoti hain, har ek aise likhi gayi ki jaanchi ja sake Chapter 7
access control
niyam jo tay karte hain ki kaun sa user kaun sa document ya chunk dekh sakta hai, application aur data layer mein laagu kiye gaye, model se nahi poochhe gaye Chapter 35
activation moment
woh pehli baar jab ek user ko woh value milti hai jiska product waada karta hai; uske pehle ka sab kuch user ke liye kharcha hai Chapter 43
agentic search
model ko khud kai searches chalane dena, jo wapas aaye use padhna aur apna sawaal dobara likhna, ek loop istemaal karke Chapter 23
AI agent
ek model, function ka ek set jo woh maang sakta hai, ek loop, aur kab rukna hai uska ek niyam Chapter 20
AI value chain
un layers ki shrinkhala jin par ek AI product bana hota hai: infrastructure, models, tooling aur, sabse upar, woh applications jo log istemaal karte hain; har layer ka fayda kisi alag cheez se aata hai Chapter 31
allowlist
un cheezon ki list jo ek system ko karne ki ijaazat hai; jo uspar nahi hai woh mana kar di jaati hai Chapter 45
answer key
guard ka test set: har udaharan vaakya ke liye, theek-theek kya milna chahiye aur uske saath kya hona chahiye, numbered versions mein rakha hua Chapter 12
API
ek program ka doosre program se ek tay format mein kuch maangne ka tareeka, jaise counter ke aar-paar thamayi gayi order slip Chapter 9
API key
ek lamba gupt code jo provider ko batata hai ki kaun maang raha hai, aur bill kise bhejna hai; jiske paas yeh hai woh aapka paisa kharch kar sakta hai Chapter 9
architecture decision record
ek bade technical faisle ka chhota note: vikalp, chunav, saboot, nateeje, aur kya hone par aap use dobara dekhenge Chapter 40
attack surface
woh sab jagahein jahan ek bahari kisi system mein kuch daal sakta hai ya woh kuch pahunch sakta hai jo woh kar sakta hai; har tool, input aur connection ise badhata hai Chapter 39
attention
transformer ka woh hissa jo har token ke liye tay karta hai ki agla kya aayega yeh andaaza lagane ke liye baaki kaun se tokens sabse zyada maayne rakhte hain Chapter 8
audit trail
kaam se alag rakha gaya ek record, ki kisne kya kiya, kab, kis niyam ke tahat aur kis nateeje ke saath, kisi ghatna ko punarnirmit karne ke liye kaafi Chapter 39

B

B2B
business to business: aisa product jo companies ko becha jaata hai, jahan paisa dene wala aksar wahi insaan nahi hota jo use chalata hai Chapter 2
B2C
business to consumer: aisa product jo ek-ek insaan ko becha jaata hai, jo khareedne wale bhi hain aur istemaal karne wale bhi Chapter 2
bottom-up estimate
aisa size ka andaaza jo aise customers se banta hai jinhe aap gin sakte hain, aur har ek kitna dega usse guna kiya jaata hai, na ki kisi industry report ka ek tukda Chapter 4
bounded agent
ek AI agent jise kadmon, samay aur kharche par kadi seemayein, ek state jo woh saaf roop se rakhta hai, aur ek "tay nahi kar sakta" ant diya gaya hai, taaki woh hamesha ruk jaye Chapter 36

C

caching
provider ko request ka process kiya hua shuruaati hissa yaad rakhne dena, taaki agar agli baar woh bilkul wahi ho toh baad ki request sasti aur tez ho Chapter 21
canary release
ek badlaav ko pehle users ke ek chhote hisse ko dikhana, purane version ko taiyaar rakh kar, sabko milne se pehle Chapter 38
cascade
aisa design jo har request ko us sabse sasti cheez ke paas bhejta hai jo kaam kar sakti hai, aur sirf jo jaanch mein fail hota hai use agle, mehnge ke paas bhejta hai Chapter 26
case study
ek project ka ek ya do page ka byora: problem aur uska saboot, aapke faisle aur jin vikalpon ko aapne thukraya, trade-offs, numbers ke saath nateeje, kya fail hua, aur aage aap kya karenge Chapter 47
changelog
har release mein kya badla uski chhoti public list, users ke liye vyavaharik shabdon mein likhi gayi Chapter 46
chunk
ek lambe document ka ek tukda, itna chhota ki akela store kiya aur bheja ja sake Chapter 14
chunking
lambe documents ko chunks mein todna, yaani yeh tay karna ki kahan kaatna hai Chapter 14
claim audit
AI se likhe saar ke das daave lena aur har ek ko uske source se jaanchna, har ek ko samarthit, aanshik roop se samarthit ya asamarthit chinhit karna Chapter 45
classifier
ek program jo har input ko tay categories ke set mein se ek mein daalta hai, jaise PAN, Aadhaar, mobile number ya inmein se koi nahi Chapter 13
code check
aam code ki kuch lines jo apne aap jawaab ke ek pehlu ko test karti hain, jaise kya quote kiya hua phrase sach mein message mein hai; har badlaav par chalane ke liye muft Chapter 25
cohort
users ka ek group jisne ek hi avadhi mein shuru kiya, samay ke saath saath dekha gaya Chapter 44
compaction
ek lambi baatcheet ko chhota karna, uske beech ka saar likh kar aur shuruaat aur ant ko rakh kar Chapter 21
competitor teardown
har vikalp ko saath-saath rakh kar dekhna: woh kiske liye hai, kitne ka hai, kahan mazboot hai, aur kahan customers shikayat karte hain Chapter 4
context engineering
har request mein kya jaayega, kis kram mein, aur kya chhoda jaayega, yeh tay karna: nirdesh, udaharan, saboot, history aur tool ke nateeje Chapter 21
context judge
guard ka teesra hissa: yeh un chhote vaakyon ko padhta hai jinhe pehle do hisse tay nahi kar paaye aur faisla karta hai ki woh kisi insaan ki taraf ishaara karte hain ya nahi Chapter 7
context window
ek baar mein model kitna text le sakta hai, uski seema, jisme aap jo bhejte hain aur jo woh wapas likhta hai dono gine jaate hain Chapter 8
contextual retrieval
har chunk ko store karne se pehle ek vaakya jodna jo batata hai ki woh apne document mein kahan baitha hai, taaki ek anaath chunk apna matlab banaye rakhe Chapter 23
contribution margin
ek customer aapke paas kya chhodta hai un kharchon ke baad jo unke saath badhte hain, jo woh dete hain uske hisse ke roop mein Chapter 42
conversation history
chat ke pichhle messages, jinhe app ko har naye message ke saath dobara bhejna padta hai agar woh chahta hai ki model ko yaad rakhta hua lage Chapter 10
cost of delay
jo aap har us hafte khote hain jab tak koi option intezaar karta hai Chapter 5

D

dark pattern
aisa design jo users ko unke apne hit ke khilaaf kaam karne ke liye bahkata hai, jaise pehle se tick kiya hua box, jhoothi kami ya chhupa hua cancellation Chapter 43
data contract
ek system ka ek hissa jo data usse milta hai uske baare mein jo anakahe maan leta hai, jaise ki ek field maujood hoga aur ek list khaali nahi hogi Chapter 33
data residency
woh desh ya kshetra jahan ek provider aapka bheja hua store aur process karta hai Chapter 28
decision log
ek chalta hua page jisme aap har zaroori faisla likhte hain, uske peeche ka saboot likhte hain, aur yeh bhi ki kya hone par aap apna faisla badal denge Chapter 1
decision memo
ek chhota document jo is tarah likha jaata hai ki vyast insaan uska pehla paragraph padh kar faisla kar sake Chapter 6
deletion drill
yeh maan lena ki ek customer ne apna data delete karne ko kaha hai aur woh har jagah dhoondhna jahan woh rehta hai, yeh jaanne ke liye ki kaun si jagahon tak aap pahunch nahi sakte Chapter 29
delivery
product banane ka woh hissa jahan aap use achhe se banate hain: plan, specification, code, quality Chapter 2
dependency
koi bhi cheez jo aapko apni team ke bahar se chahiye khatam karne ke liye: doosri team ka kaam, supplier, data ka access, koi manzoori Chapter 6
design partner
ek shuruaati user jo ek adhoore product ko istemaal karne aur aapko imaandari se batane par sahmat hota hai ki use kya mila, badle mein kuch nyayochit lekar Chapter 46
diagnosis
strategy ka pehla hissa: challenge asal mein kya hai, iska imaandaar byora, yeh kehne se pehle ki uske baare mein kya karna hai Chapter 5
discovery
product banane ka woh hissa jahan aap pata lagate hain ki problem asli hai ya nahi aur hal karne layak hai ya nahi Chapter 2
distribution
product banane ka woh hissa jahan log use dhoondhte hain, aazmate hain aur istemaal karte rehte hain Chapter 2
document audit
kuch bhi banane se pehle, ek random namoone se ginna ki sangrah ka kitna hissa saaf digital text hai, kitna scan hai, aur kitne ka matlab tables aur layout mein hai Chapter 27
DPDP Act
India ka Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, jo un sansthaon ke liye kartavya tay karta hai jo personal data sambhalti hain, use dhoondhne aur chhupane se kahin zyada Chapter 29

E

edge case
ek anokha input ya halat jo woh cheezein tod deta hai jinhe aam cases kabhi chhoote nahi Chapter 7
embedding
numbers ki ek lambi list jo text ke ek tukde ko matlabon ke naqshe par ek jagah deti hai, taaki milte-julte matlab wale texts ko milte-julte numbers milein chahe unme koi shabd saajha na ho Chapter 16
environment variable
code ke bahar, us jagah rakhi ek value jahan program chalta hai, jahan passwords aur API keys ki jagah hai Chapter 33
error analysis
sau asli outputs padhna, har ek mein kya galat hua woh apne shabdon mein likhna, notes ko group karna, groups ko naam dena aur unhe ginna Chapter 25
event taxonomy
ek product jo events record karta hai unki list, ek naming niyam ke saath jise sab follow karein, jaise lower case mein object_action aur bhoot kaal Chapter 44
evidence pack
woh cheezein ka set jo kisi doosre ko aapke daavon par bharosa karne ki jagah unhe jaanchne deta hai Chapter 41
exit cost
ek provider ko chhodne aur doosre par jaane mein paise, samay aur jokhim mein kitna kharcha aayega; ek vendor quality mein jeet sakta hai aur phir bhi aapko saalon ke liye bandh sakta hai Chapter 40
experiment runner
ek dobara istemaal hone wala program jo har experiment ke liye inputs, outputs, settings, samay aur errors record karta hai, taaki ek nateeja dohraya aur tulna kiya ja sake Chapter 33

F

failure class
ek kism ki failure, ek hi ghatna nahi; yahi das tests ko das kisson ki jagah arthpurn banata hai Chapter 41
failure threshold
woh nateeja, pilot shuru hone se pehle likha hua, jisse neeche aap use failure kahenge Chapter 32
feasibility
kya team sach-much use bana sakti hai, jitna time, hunar, data aur paisa uske paas hai usmein Chapter 2
feature flag
chalte system mein ek switch jo ek badlaav ko kuch users ke liye on aur doosron ke liye off karta hai, bina nayi release ke Chapter 45
findings document
kya toota, saboot, mool karan, ilaaj, aur jaan-boojh kar kya nahi suljhaya gaya, uska ek kachcha, tathyatmak record; brochure ka ulta Chapter 41
fine-tuning
model ko aapke apne udaharanon par aur train karna, taaki woh ek jaise tareeke se behave kare; yeh vyavahaar sikhata hai, tathya nahi Chapter 31
five whys
har jawaab par baar-baar "kyun?" poochhna, taaki lakshan se karanon ki taraf pahunchein Chapter 3
fixed workflow
pehle se tay, code mein likhe charno ka ek kram, jisme model sirf unhi charno ke liye istemaal hota hai jinhe vivek chahiye Chapter 36
flywheel
ek loop jisme product ka istemaal use behtar banata hai, jo zyada istemaal laata hai; workflow wala kism aamtaur par sabse mazboot hai Chapter 42
Fogg behaviour model
yeh idea ki ek vyavahaar tab hota hai jab motivation, kshamata aur ek prompt ek hi pal par milte hain; agar woh nahi ho raha, toh unhe ulte kram mein jaancho Chapter 43

G

generative AI
aisa AI jo naya content banata hai, jaise text, images ya code, sirf ek label ya number dene ke bajaye Chapter 8
Git
ek tool jo aapke kaam ka har version save karta hai, taaki aap dekh sakein ki kya badla aur kisi bhi pichhle version par wapas ja sakein Chapter 33
golden dataset
cases ka versioned, pratinidhi set, apekshit vyavahaar ke saath, jo tay karta hai ki ek system ke liye achha ka matlab kya hai; ise ek version number chahiye taaki nateeja dobara chalaya ja sake Chapter 38
graceful degradation
jab system ka koi hissa fail ho toh ek kam, par surakshit tareeke se kaam karte rehna, poori tarah fail hone ki jagah Chapter 40
gross margin
aay ghata product pahunchane ka seedha kharcha; AI products ke liye us kharche ka bahut hissa ek model ya hosting ka bill hota hai Chapter 42
grounded answer
aisa jawaab jo system ke diye saboot se likha gaya ho, aur jise us tak wapas dhoondha ja sake, na ki us se jo model ko ittefaq se yaad hai Chapter 18
growth loop
ek chakra jisme ek user ke kaam agle user ko laate hain, taaki output wapas input mein jaaye Chapter 43
guardrail metric
aisa number jo key results ke peeche bhaagte hue kharab nahi hona chahiye Chapter 6
guiding policy
strategy ka doosra hissa: challenge ke liye aapka poora tareeka, jisme woh bhi shaamil hai jo aap karne se mana karenge Chapter 5

H

hallucination
ek vishwas bhara, achhe se bana jawaab jo man se gadha gaya hai; yeh isliye hota hai ki model sambhav text predict karta hai, aur "mujhe nahi pata" shayad hi sabse sambhav text hota hai Chapter 11
harness
model ke aas-paas ki har cheez jo use product banati hai: woh code jo uska context banata hai, uske tools chalata hai, state rakhta hai, niyam laagu karta hai, quality jaanchta hai aur record karta hai ki kya hua Chapter 45
HTTP
niyamon ka woh set jisse programs internet par requests aur jawaab bhejte hain, har jawaab par ek number ke saath jo batata hai ki kaam hua ya nahi Chapter 33
human oversight
ek insaan jo kisi output ka saboot dekh sakta hai, aur use thukra sakta hai; outputs ko guzarte dekhna isme nahi ginta Chapter 29
hybrid pricing
ek platform fee jisme kuch istemaal shaamil hai, phir usse aage ke liye ek charge; kharidar ke liye andaaza lagane yogya aur aapke margin ki raksha karne wala Chapter 42
hybrid search
keyword search aur matlab-aadharit search ko ek saath chalana aur dono ki rankings ko milana, taaki aapko dono mein se ek chunna na pade Chapter 23

I

idempotency
kisi action ka woh gun ki use do baar chalana surakshit hai, ya aise surakshit kiya gaya hai ki do baar chalane ka sirf ek asar ho; yeh tay karta hai ki retry surakshit hai ya nahi Chapter 36
incident review
kuch galat hone ke baad likha gaya ek chhota likhit byora, ki kya hua, kyun, aur kaun si jaanch use pakad leti Chapter 45
inference
taiyaar model ko kisi request ka jawaab dene ke liye chalana; har baar paisa lagta hai aur model badalta nahi Chapter 8
informed consent
ek insaan ki sahmati, saaf-saaf bataye jaane ke baad ki kya ikattha hota hai, kahan jaata hai, kya galat ho sakta hai aur kaise waapas ja sakte hain Chapter 46
ingestion
documents ko system mein padhne ka kadam, jisme unhe scan karna, parse karna aur todna shaamil hai; yahan jo kuch kho jaata hai woh hamesha ke liye kho jaata hai Chapter 35
input metric
aisa number jise team seedha badal sakti hai aur jisse aap umeed karte hain ki nateeja hilega Chapter 6
instruction tuning
model banane ka doosra daur, jisme use nirdeshon aur achhe jawaabon ke jode ke udaharanon par train kiya jaata hai taaki woh nirdesh maane Chapter 8

J

job to be done
woh tarakki jo ek insaan apni zindagi mein karna chahta hai, aur jis ke liye woh kisi product ko "kaam par rakhta" hai Chapter 3
JSON
jaankari ko curly braces ke andar labels aur values ki tarah likhne ka saral tareeka, jo lagbhag har API istemaal karti hai Chapter 9

K

key result
ek objective ke neeche ke teen-chaar numbers mein se ek jo dikhata hai ki aap wahan pahunche ya nahi; woh naapta hai ki logon ke liye kya badla, yeh nahi ki aapne kya ship kiya Chapter 6
keyword search
text ko sawaal ke shabdon ko documents ke shabdon se milaakar dhoondhna; yeh spelling ki tulna karta hai, matlab ki nahi Chapter 15
kill criterion
pehle se likhi hui ek shart, jiske poora hone ka matlab hai ki aap kaam rok dete hain Chapter 6
kill switch
ek flag jo traffic ko turant ek saade non-AI raaste par bhej deta hai, bina nayi deployment ke; yeh tabhi kaam karta hai jab woh raasta maujood ho aur haal hi mein test kiya gaya ho Chapter 30

L

language model
ek program jisne bahut saare likhe hue text se seekha hai ki aage kaun sa text aayega, iska andaaza lagana; chatbot ke peeche yahi baitha hota hai Chapter 8
latency
poochhne aur jawaab paane ke beech ka samay, jise users raftaar ki tarah mehsoos karte hain Chapter 22
latency budget
woh kul samay jo ek request le sakti hai, un charno ke beech baanta hua jinse woh guzarti hai, taaki sabse dheema charan dhoondha jaye aur uska ek malik ho Chapter 40
leaderboard
models ki unke scores ke aadhar par ek prakashit ranking, kisi aur ke tests par Chapter 34
leading question
aisa sawaal jo poochhne wale ke man ka jawaab hi saamne wale ke munh mein daal deta hai Chapter 3
least privilege
ek system ko sirf utna access dena jitne ki use asal mein zaroorat hai, taaki agar use dhokha diya jaye toh nuksaan seemit rahe Chapter 39
lethal trifecta
woh teen cheezein jo milkar kisi system ko khatarnaak banati hain: nijee data tak pahunch, aise text se samna jo bahari log likh sakte hain, aur kuch bahar bhejne ka ek tareeka Chapter 24
LLM judge
ek model jo doosre model ke output ko grade karta hai; sasta aur tez, lekin uske biases hote hain aur bharosa karne se pehle use aapki apni grading se jaanchna padta hai Chapter 25
lock-in
ek provider se bandh jaana kyunki chhodna bahut mehnga padega, dobara likhne, dobara naapne ya khoye hue features mein Chapter 31

M

mask
kisi detail ka ek hissa chhupana par uski shape rakhna, jaise 98******12 Chapter 7
MCP
Model Context Protocol: AI applications ko tools aur data se jodne ka ek standard, taaki koi bhi compliant tool kisi bhi compliant application mein fit ho, plug aur socket ki tarah Chapter 36
metadata filtering
koi bhi score hone se pehle un chunks ko hata dena jo sahi nahi ho sakte, unse jude labels ke zariye jaise version, tareekhein aur kaun dekh sakta hai Chapter 23
minimum detectable effect
sabse chhota badlaav jise pakadna kaam ka hai; yeh tay karta hai ki ek test ko kitne users chahiye Chapter 44
model selection card
ek chhota, versioned page jo kaam, quality ka lakshya, data, raftaar aur kharche ki seemayein, aazmaye gaye vikalp, saboot aur fallback record karta hai, taaki ek reviewer theek-theek dekh sake ki ek model kyun chuna gaya Chapter 34
MoSCoW
scope par sahmati banane ka tareeka, cheezon ko Must, Should, Could aur Won't mein baant kar Chapter 5
multimodal
sirf text se zyada lene mein saksham, jaise pages, tasveerein, tables aur bhaashan, jo badal deta hai ki saboot kise kehte hain aur use kaise dhoondha jaata hai Chapter 37
must-keep list
har document ke liye woh tathya jo padhne wale ko nahi khone chahiye, jiske khilaaf har saar jaancha jaata hai Chapter 13
MVP
minimum viable product: sabse chhoti cheez jo asli users ke saath aapki sabse risky assumption ko aazmaye Chapter 7

N

name-and-place finder
guard ka doosra hissa: yeh un details ko dhoondhta hai jinki koi tay shape nahi, jaise kisi insaan ka naam, pata ya employer Chapter 7
network effect
product ka sabke liye behtar hona jaise zyada log use istemaal karte hain, jo users dwara doosre users ko laane se alag hai Chapter 43
North Star
ek vaakya jo batata hai ki aapke customers ko kya value milti hai, aur ek number jo use naapta hai Chapter 5

O

observability
system ke rakhe records se dekh paana ki usne kya kiya aur kyun, andaaza lagaye bina Chapter 38
observation session
ek meeting jisme aap kisi ko ek asli kaam dete hain aur use bina madad kiye karte dekhte hain, har baar wahi cheezein note karte hue Chapter 46
OCR
optical character recognition: software jo text ki tasveer ko text mein badalta hai, aamtaur par kuch galtiyon ke saath Chapter 27
OKR
objectives and key results: shabdon mein likha ek goal, kuch numbers ke saath jo dikhate hain ki aap wahan pahunche Chapter 6
open-weight model
aisa model jiske weights prakashit hain, taaki aap use download karke apne computers par chala sakein, kisi aur ka bulane ki jagah Chapter 31
opportunity tree
ek drawing jo us nateeje se shuru hoti hai jo aap chahte hain, interviews mein logon ne jo zaroorat batayi usme shaakhein banati hai, aur sambhaavit hal par khatam hoti hai Chapter 4
orphaned chunk
aisa chunk jiska document se kaat dene ke baad koi matlab nahi nikalta, kyunki woh kisi aisi cheez ka zikr karta hai jo pichhle tukde mein thi Chapter 14
outcome pricing
har safal nateeje ke liye paisa lena, taaki daam value ke saath chale; ise safalta ki ek sahmat, naapne yogya paribhasha chahiye Chapter 42

P

p95
woh samay jise 100 mein se 95 requests haraati hain; yeh dheeli poonchh dikhata hai jo ek ausat chhupa leta hai Chapter 38
parser
woh program jo kisi file, jaise PDF, ko text aur sanrachna mein badalta hai; uski galtiyan baad ki har cheez ke liye adrishya hoti hain Chapter 35
pattern checker
guard ka pehla hissa: yeh un details ko dhoondhta hai jo hamesha ek hi shape ki hoti hain, jaise PAN ya mobile number, tay niyamon se Chapter 7
persona
ek tarah ke user ka chhota sa vivaran, jo sirf interviews mein jo dikha usi se banaya gaya ho Chapter 3
PII
personally identifiable information: koi bhi aisi detail jo ek asli insaan ki taraf ishaara kar sake, jaise naam, phone number ya pehchaan ka number Chapter 1
pilot
ek seemit trial jo yeh dikhane ke liye design kiya gaya ho ki ek feature business ki madad karta hai ya nahi, aur jo pehle se batata hai ki kaun sa nateeja failure maana jaayega Chapter 32
pinned version
model ka woh version jise aapne naam se tay kar diya hai, taaki provider aapko bataye bina use aapke neeche se badal na sake Chapter 30
positioning statement
ek vaakya jo batata hai ki product kiske liye hai aur doosre vikalpon se alag kyun hai Chapter 4
PRD
product requirements document: woh kaagaz jo batata hai ki kya banana hai aur kyun, problem aur uske saboot se shuru karke Chapter 7
pre-mortem
ek meeting jisme sab kalpana karte hain ki project fail ho gaya, aur shuru hone se pehle likhte hain ki kyun Chapter 6
pre-training
model banane ka pehla aur sabse mehnga daur, jisme woh bahut saare text par agla token predict karna seekhta hai Chapter 8
precision
tool ne jitna flag kiya, usme se kitna sach mein wahi tha jo usne kaha; agar usne 100 flag kiye aur 80 asli the, toh precision 80 percent hai Chapter 17
predictive AI
aisa AI jo ek khaas kaam ke liye label ya number deta hai, jaise koi message spam hai ya nahi Chapter 8
problem statement
ek ya do vaakya jo batayein ki problem kiski hai, kya hai, aur aaj ki date mein unhein kya padti hai Chapter 3
product risk
un chaar cheezon mein se ek jo product ko doba sakti hain: koi use chahta nahi, koi use chala nahi sakta, use banaya nahi ja sakta, ya woh apna kharcha nahi nikaal sakta Chapter 2
product sense
ek user chunne, uski asli problem dhoondhne aur ek samajhdaar hal sujhane ki kshamata, jise interviewers "vyast mata-pitaon ke liye ek product design karo" jaise sawaalon se parakhte hain Chapter 47
product-led growth
users ko khud sign up karne aur value paane dekar customers jeetna, kuch ke upgrade karne ke saath; yeh tab fit hota hai jab value minuton mein dikhe aur keemat kam ho Chapter 43
production delta
ek kaam karte prototype aur ek chalti service ke beech jo kuch gayab hai uski list, jaise pehchaan, retries, queues, monitoring, secrets, backups aur rollback Chapter 40
project memory
code ke saath rakhi ek saadi file, jisme project ke niyam aur aadatein hain, ek coding assistant ke har run ki shuruaat mein load hoti hui Chapter 45
prompt
woh text jo aap model ko bhejte hain, jisme nirdesh, udaharan aur woh material ho sakta hai jis par use kaam karna hai Chapter 11
prompt injection
us material ke andar ka text jo system se padhne ko kaha gaya hai aur model ko nirdesh deta hai, jinhe model maan sakta hai kyunki woh bharose se aapke nirdeshon ko un shabdon se alag nahi kar sakta jo use padhne ko diye gaye Chapter 24
prototype
ek mota, sasta version jo asli ke bante se pehle kuch seekhne ke liye banaya jaata hai Chapter 7
provenance
is baat ka record ki koi cheez kahan se aayi, taaki ek daava ya faisla uske source, version aur use paida karne wale code tak dhoondha ja sake Chapter 34
Python
woh programming bhasha jisme zyadatar AI ka kaam likha jaata hai; ek product manager ke liye, yeh theek-theek kehne ka tareeka ki ek experiment kya karta hai Chapter 33

Q

quasi-identifier
aisi detail jo akeli nirdosh hai par doosron ke saath milkar ek insaan ki taraf ishaara kar sakti hai, jaise umar, gaon aur ek durlabh bimari Chapter 7

R

reasoning model
aisa model jo jawaab dene se pehle apna kaam likh kar nikalta hai, ek tareeka aazmata hai aur jaanchta hai; us kaam ka paisa aap har request par dete hain, paise mein bhi aur intezaar ke samay mein bhi Chapter 22
recall
jitni asli cheezein dhoondhni thin, unmein se tool ne kitne ka hissa dhoondha; agar 100 thin aur usne 90 dhoondhin, toh recall 90 percent hai Chapter 17
red team
woh log jinka kaam jaan-boojh kar ek system par hamla karna hai, taaki uski kamzoriyan pehle unhe milein Chapter 39
redact
kisi detail ko poori tarah hata dena, jaise use [PAN] shabd se badal kar Chapter 7
refusal
system ka saaf kehna ki woh kuch nahi kar sakta aur ek insaan tak ka raasta dena, jo jaan-boojh kar design kiya jaata hai aur ittefaq par nahi chhoda jaata Chapter 32
regression
aisa badlaav jo system ko us cheez mein kharab banata hai jo woh pehle achhe se karta tha Chapter 38
release gate
ek swachalit jaanch jo golden dataset ko ek badlaav ke khilaaf chalati hai aur release rok deti hai agar koi number apni seema se neeche gire Chapter 38
repository
Git mein rakha woh folder jisme ek project ka saara kaam aur uski history hai Chapter 33
reranking
sasta karke bahut saare ummeedwaar tukde laana, phir ek dheema, zyada saavdhaan model se sawaal aur har tukde ko saath padhwa kar sabse achhe kuch ko upar rakhwana Chapter 23
residual risk
woh jokhim jo controls lagne ke baad bacha rehta hai, jise likhna chahiye aur door maan nahi lena chahiye Chapter 39
retention
ek provider aapka bheja hua kitni der tak rakhta hai, jo jawaab dene mein lage samay se bahut zyada ho sakta hai Chapter 28
retrieval
aapke documents ke woh tukde dhoondhne ka kadam jo sawaal ke liye kaam ke lagte hain Chapter 18
retrieval-augmented generation
RAG: aisa design jisme system pehle aapke documents ke woh tukde dhoondhta hai jo sawaal ke liye kaam ke lagte hain, phir unhe sawaal ke saath model ko deta hai taaki woh unse jawaab likhe Chapter 18
RICE
options ko Reach guna Impact guna Confidence, bhaag Effort, se score karne ka tareeka Chapter 5
risk register
ek table jo har jokhim ko uske malik, uske control, saboot ki control kaam karta hai, aur kitna jokhim bacha hai, ke saath list karti hai Chapter 39
risk tier
ek star, jo is baat se tay hota hai ki galat jawaab kitna nuksaan kar sakta hai, jo tay karta hai ki kisi system ko kitne documentation, jaanch aur saboot ki zaroorat hai; istemaal tier tay karta hai, technology nahi Chapter 29
riskiest assumption
woh baat jo sach honi hi chahiye taaki aapka idea chale, aur jis par aapko sabse kam yakeen hai, isliye jise sabse pehle aazmana hai Chapter 3
roadmap
aisa plan jo dikhata hai ki team kis par kaam karegi aur lagbhag kab; kaam ka roadmap dates ki jagah teen column mein nateejon ka waada karta hai, Now, Next aur Later Chapter 6
role matrix
ek table jisme asli job advertisements jin skills ko maangte hain woh ek taraf neeche aur roles upar hain, jisme aap har skill ko apne liye proven, aanshik roop se proven ya gayab chinhit karte hain Chapter 47
rollback
code ke pichhle version par laut jaana, jiske liye nayi deployment chahiye aur jo madad nahi karta jab dono versions ek jaisa kharab vyavahaar saajha karte hain Chapter 30
rollback trigger
ek naapne yogya shart, pehle se likhi hui, jo kisi ko ek release ko palatne par baadhya karti hai Chapter 45
routing
har request ko us sabse sasti model ke paas bhejna jo use sambhal sake, aur sirf mushkil wali ko ek mazboot aur mehnge ke paas Chapter 34
rule-keeper
guard ka chautha hissa: yeh tay karta hai ki mili hui har detail ke saath kya karna hai, jaise hata do, mask karo, jaane do ya poochho Chapter 7

S

SAM
serviceable addressable market: TAM ka woh hissa jise aap apne paas jo hai usse sach-much sambhal sakte hain Chapter 4
schema
is baat ka ek aupchaarik vivaran ki jawaab ki theek-theek kya shape honi chahiye, jise provider tab laagu karwata hai jab model likh raha hota hai Chapter 19
scoreboard
woh table jo tool ke har version ke liye gintaa hai ki usne kya dhoondha, kya chhoda aur galti se kya flag kiya Chapter 12
SDK
software development kit: ek chhoti library aur ek demo jise koi doosra developer apne product mein jod sakta hai bina khud woh feature banaye Chapter 41
seat pricing
product ke har user ke liye, prati mahine paisa lena; kharidar ke liye budget banana aasaan lekin anuchit jab zyada istemaal karne wale kam istemaal karne walon se kahin zyada mehnge padte hain Chapter 42
shadow AI
staff ka khud se consumer AI tools istemaal karna, aksar internal documents paste karke, kyunki tools kaam ke hain aur koi manzoor shuda cheez utni achhi nahi Chapter 29
similarity score
lagbhag 0 se 1 ke beech ek number jo batata hai ki do embeddings kitne qareeb hain; iska kuch matlab tab tak nahi jab tak aap jaanein na ki saaf achhe aur saaf bure matches kitna score karte hain Chapter 16
SOM
serviceable obtainable market: SAM ka woh hissa jo aap lagbhag teen saal mein sach mein jeet sakte hain Chapter 4
speaker attribution
yeh pata lagana ki kisne kaun se shabd kahe, ek recording mein; yeh technical dikhta hai aur ek privacy faisle ki tarah behave karta hai Chapter 37
speech-to-text
software jo record kiye hue bhaashan ko likhe hue shabdon mein badalta hai; yeh kisi bhi voice system ka pehla charan hai aur woh pehli jagah jahan matlab kho sakta hai Chapter 37
sprint
ek tay avadhi, aamtaur par ek ya do hafte, jisme team plan karti hai, banati hai, dikhati hai aur review karti hai Chapter 7
staging
live system ki ek copy jahan badlaav pehle aazmaye jaate hain, taaki ek kharab badlaav asli users tak kabhi na pahunche Chapter 40
stakeholder
koi bhi jo project ki madad ya rok kar sakta hai, ya jis par uska asar padta hai Chapter 6
STAR method
apne beete hue ke baare mein ek kahani chaar hisson mein sunane ka tareeka: situation, task, action aur result, jisme zyadatar samay is par lagta hai ki aapne kya kiya Chapter 47
state machine
ek workflow jisme aapka code har charan aur ek charan se doosre tak har permitted chaal tay karta hai Chapter 45
stateless
requests ke beech kuch bhi na rakhna: har call shoonya se shuru hoti hai, aur model ko nahi pata ki aapne abhi ek pal pehle baat ki thi Chapter 10
status code
ek HTTP jawaab par ka number: 200 matlab kaam hua, 4xx number matlab request galat thi, aur 5xx number matlab server fail hua Chapter 33
status quo
log aaj jo karte hain, kuch na karna bhi usme shaamil; aksar sabse mazboot competitor Chapter 4
step limit
ek AI agent rukne se pehle zyada se zyada kitne daur le sakta hai, jo program tay karta hai, model ke bharose nahi chhoda jaata Chapter 20
streaming
jawaab ko screen par tukde-tukde bhejna jaise woh likha ja raha ho, poora hone tak intezaar karne ke bajaye Chapter 22
structured output
naam wale, type wale fields mein diya gaya jawaab jise ek program padh sake, na ki ek paragraph jise insaan padhe Chapter 19
sub-agent
ek bade kaam ke ek hisse ke liye diya gaya ek madadgaar, jo apne alag context mein kaam karta hai taaki mukhya wala chhota rahe Chapter 45
support log
madad ke har anurodh ka chalta hua record, uski category aur jis account se aaya uske saath, jo saptahik roop se product ke baare mein saboot ki tarah padha jaata hai Chapter 46
system card
ek AI system ka ek page ka vivaran: woh kis liye hai, woh kaun sa data istemaal karta hai, use kaise test kiya gaya, woh kya galat karta hai aur use kis kaam ke liye istemaal nahi karna chahiye Chapter 29
system prompt
woh sthayi nirdesh jo ek app har request ke saath bhejta hai, yeh batate hue ki assistant kaun hai aur use kya karna aur kya nahi karna hai Chapter 11
system-design interview
ek baatcheet jisme aapse ek AI feature zor se design karne ko kaha jaata hai, aur aapko approach, evaluation, failure, kharcha aur rollout ke baare mein tark par parakha jaata hai, code par nahi Chapter 47

T

take-home
ek employer dwara diya gaya kaam jo ek tay samay seema mein akele karna hota hai, jo parakhta hai ki jab koi nahi dekh raha tab aap kaise kaam karte hain Chapter 47
TAM
total addressable market: woh sab log jinhe yeh problem hai, us keemat par jo aap lagayenge Chapter 4
task type
paanch kismon ke kaam mein se kaun sa ek request asal mein hai: classify, extract, summarise, rewrite ya generate Chapter 12
temperature
ek setting jo tay karti hai ki model kitni baar agla kam sambhav token chunta hai; kam par har baar milte-julte jawaab aate hain, zyada par zyada variety Chapter 11
test set
asli ya yatharth udaharanon ka ek sangrah, har ek ke saath pehle se likha sahi jawaab, jo kisi system ko naapne ke kaam aata hai Chapter 12
time-box
anishchit kaam ko diya gaya tay samay, jiske ant mein faisla hota hai Chapter 7
time-to-value
ek naye user ko activation moment tak pahunchne mein kitna samay lagta hai, sign-up se naapa gaya Chapter 43
token
text ka ek tukda, aksar poora shabd aur kabhi-kabhi shabd ka ek hissa, jo woh ikai hai jise models padhte hain aur jiske hisaab se providers paisa lete hain Chapter 8
token budget
ek plan jo request ke har hisse ko tokens ka uska hissa deta hai, ek aise insaan ke saath jo kul ka malik hai aur jaanta hai ki pehle kya kaatna hai Chapter 21
tool calling
model ko apne program se kisi function ko chalwane ke liye kehne dena, function aur uske arguments ka naam lekar; program use chalata hai aur nateeja wapas bhej deta hai Chapter 20
tool contract
ek function jo model bula sakta hai uska theek-theek likhit samjhauta: uska naam, woh kya karta hai aur kya nahi, uske parameters, uski errors, uske side effects aur use kaun bula sakta hai Chapter 36
tool description
text ki woh kuch lines jo model ko batati hain ki function kya karta hai, kya lautata hai aur kya nahi; model unhe padh kar function chunta hai, isliye dhundhli description ek bug hai Chapter 20
toolchain
un tools ka set jo ek team product banane aur chalane ke liye istemaal karti hai, slots ki tarah socha gaya, har ek ka ek kaam Chapter 45
trace record
ek request ke system se poore raaste ka saheja hua record: input, versions, charan, samay, kharcha aur nateeja Chapter 38
tracking plan
woh saajha document jo har event, uske properties, woh kab fire hota hai aur uska malik kaun hai, list karta hai, jisse engineers banate hain aur analysts bharosa karte hain Chapter 44
transformer
woh design jis par lagbhag saare aadhunik language models bane hain, jiska mukhya hissa attention hai Chapter 8

U

usability
kya log bina madad ke khud samajh sakte hain ki cheez kaise istemaal karni hai Chapter 2
usability test
ek asli insaan ko prototype se koi kaam poora karte hue dekhna, bina use madad diye Chapter 7
usage block
har jawaab ka woh hissa jo batata hai ki kitne tokens andar gaye aur kitne bahar aaye, jiske hisaab se aapse paisa liya jaata hai Chapter 9
usage pricing
har ikai ke liye paisa lena, jaise har message ya call, taaki aay kharche ke saath chale; kharidar bill ka andaaza nahi laga sakte aur istemaal rok sakte hain Chapter 42
user interview
aisi baatcheet jo yeh jaanne ke liye hoti hai ki ek insaan ne asal mein kya kiya aur use kya chahiye tha, yeh nahi ki use aapka idea pasand aayega ya nahi Chapter 3
user story
value ka ek hissa user ki taraf se bataya gaya: woh kaun hain, kya chahte hain, aur kyun Chapter 7

V

validation
jawaab aane ke baad use niyamon ke khilaaf jaanchna, jaise kya ek zaroori field maujood hai ya kya ek quote kiya hua phrase sach mein message mein hai Chapter 19
value proposition
ek saaf bayaan ki aap kiski seva karte hain, unke liye kaun sa kaam karte hain, aur vikalpon se behtar kyun hain Chapter 5
verifier
ek jaanch, jaise ek test, jo ek agent ko batati hai ki uska apna badlaav kaam kiya ya nahi, bina kisi insaan ke har line padhe Chapter 45
vertical slice
ek patla chalta hua version jo system ki har layer se guzarta hai, taaki ek asli user jaldi kuch aazma sake Chapter 7
viability
kya product business ke liye kaam karta hai: uski kamaai, uska kharcha, kanoon, aur uski saakh Chapter 2
virality
users ka doosre users ko laana Chapter 43
voice pipeline
alag charno ki woh zanjeer jisse ek voice system guzarta hai, awaaz pakadne se lekar us par karyavahi karne tak, har ek der jodta hai aur har ek matlab badal sakta hai Chapter 37

W

wedge
woh chhota pehla istemaal jise aap saaf-saaf jeet sakte hain, itna chhota ki usme kamaal kar sakein, aur kisi bade cheez se juda hua Chapter 5
weights
model ke andar ke arabon numbers jinme woh sab kuch hai jo usne seekha; training unhe badalti hai, aam istemaal nahi Chapter 8
worked example
jis output ki aapko zaroorat hai uska ek poora kiya hua namoona, jo model ko dikhaya jaata hai taaki woh aapke vivaran ki nakal karne ke bajaye format ki copy kare Chapter 11
